display.purpose: Hero and section headlines (h1/h2/h3). Space Grotesk, weight 600, tracking-tight, text-wrap: balance.

body.purpose: All prose. Inter, weight 400, with cv02/cv03/cv04/cv11 stylistic sets enabled globally.

label.purpose: Eyebrows, stat labels, dates, and every financial/impact figure. IBM Plex Mono only — never prose.

shadows.name: resting
shadows.purpose: The only shadow present on cards at rest; always tinted with the deep ocean color, never neutral black.

shadows.name: hover-lift
shadows.purpose: Paired with a -4px translateY on clickable cards (initiatives, blog posts, partners) as the hover response.

motion.name: ease-entrance
motion.purpose: Fade-up entrance for hero copy and card grids (Framer Motion Reveal component), y:14→0, staggered ~0.05s per item.

motion.name: ease-tideline
motion.purpose: The hero's looping tideline SVG wave — the system's one piece of ambient, always-on motion.

motion.name: ease-progress-fill
motion.purpose: Progress-bar width transition on value change.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single most important action per context (Donate, Submit). Gold fill, deep ocean text, fully pill-shaped.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: #E8A233; color: #081D26; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; padding: 14px 28px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #F2B84B; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px #E8A233; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Confirm-but-not-headline action (e.g. "Volunteer for this initiative"). Solid Estuary Ink fill, white text.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: #125771; color: #fff; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; padding: 14px 28px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #146D8A; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px #E8A233; }

components.name: Gold Badge
components.description: SDG tags and impact-metric highlights. Static label, no interactive states.
components.css: .ds-badge-gold { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(242, 184, 75, 0.4); color: #C4841F; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Initiative Card
components.description: The canonical clickable card: flat at rest, lifts with a stronger ocean-tinted shadow on hover.
components.html:
Environmental Sustainability

Clean Communities Initiative

Volunteer-led clean-up and waste management education across riverside communities.
components.css: .ds-card { border-radius: 16px; border: 1px solid #DCEFF5; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(8,29,38,0.03); overflow: hidden; transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 12px 24px rgba(8,29,38,0.10); } .ds-card-header { height: 128px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: linear-gradient(to bottom right, #146D8A, #0F3549); color: #B3DFEA; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; } .ds-card-body { padding: 20px; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.125rem; color: #081D26; margin: 0 0 8px; } .ds-card-text { font-size: 0.875rem; color: #146D8A; margin: 0; }

components.name: Funding Progress Bar
components.description: Signature component: an ocean-to-leaf gradient fill visually reading as money moving from 'raised' toward 'impact'. Animates on value change.
components.css: .ds-progress { height: 8px; width: 100%; border-radius: 9999px; background: #DCEFF5; overflow: hidden; } .ds-progress-fill { height: 100%; border-radius: 9999px; background: linear-gradient(to right, #1E8AA8, #3D9A6C); transition: width 0.7s; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard field used across contact, donation, partner, and survey forms.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #DCEFF5; padding: 10px 12px; font-size: 0.875rem; background: #fff; transition: border-color 0.2s; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #1E8AA8; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #7FC8DA; }

components.name: Sticky Nav Bar
components.description: Frosted-glass sticky header with an active-route tint and gold Donate CTA.
components.html:
The Citizen Project
HomeInitiatives
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 0 20px; height: 64px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.9); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); border-bottom: 1px solid #DCEFF5; } .ds-nav-logo { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; color: #0F3549; } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-nav-link { padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: #12455B; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-link:hover { background: #EFF8FB; } .ds-nav-link-active { background: #EFF8FB; color: #081D26; }

narrative.overview:
The Citizen Project's design reads like a public ledger set on the bank of the Volta estuary: sober, factual, and accountable, with a single recurring tideline motif tying the civic mission back to its place. The system is grounded and transparent by design — confidence comes from showing real numbers plainly (mono-font stats, an ocean-to-leaf progress gradient that visually reads as "money moving toward good"), not from decorative polish. Color is used with restraint: two calm blues do most of the work, gold marks the handful of moments that matter (primary actions, SDG tags, the one accent word in the hero), and a reserved red appears only for genuine urgency.

Surfaces stay flat at rest — cards carry only a faint, ocean-tinted shadow, never a plain black one — and depth is something the interface earns through interaction (a hover lift, a focus ring) rather than something applied everywhere by default. The one moment of motion the system allows itself unprompted is the hero's tideline: a slow, looping wave beneath the headline, referencing the Volta without needing to say so.
keyCharacteristics: Three-hue palette (ocean blue, Ghana-flag gold, leaf green) doing double duty as both brand color and the entire neutral scale — there is no separate gray
Mono font (IBM Plex Mono) reserved specifically for numbers, dates, and eyebrows — a deliberate "ledger" signal, never used for prose
Fully pill-shaped buttons and badges; cards and inputs use a softer, partial radius — two distinct silhouette families, never mixed
Flat-by-default surfaces that lift only on hover/focus; shadows are always ocean-tinted, never neutral black
Red is reserved exclusively for "Critical" urgency and the active-favorite heart — it never appears decoratively

rules.name: The One Palette Rule
rules.body: There is no separate gray scale. Every neutral — backgrounds, borders, dividers, muted text — is drawn from the ocean blue scale at low saturation/high or low lightness. A gray hex value anywhere in this system is a bug, not a shortcut.

rules.name: The Reserved Red Rule
rules.body: #DC2626 (critical-red) appears in exactly two places: the "Critical" urgency map pin and the active/filled favorite heart. It is never used decoratively, for generic errors, or for anything the user did not flag as urgent.

rules.name: The Ledger Font Rule
rules.body: IBM Plex Mono renders only numbers, dates, and short uppercase labels — donation amounts, percentages, timestamps, eyebrows. The moment a paragraph of prose appears in mono, the "public ledger" signal breaks; it does not happen anywhere in this system.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows exist only as a response to hover or focus, and are always tinted with the deep ocean color — never neutral black.

dos: Do reserve IBM Plex Mono exclusively for numbers, dates, and short uppercase labels — never prose.
Do use the ocean→leaf gradient specifically for funding/progress bars; never a flat single-color fill for progress.
Do keep cards flat at rest and lift them only on hover/focus — depth is earned by interaction, not applied by default.
Do draw every border and neutral tone from the ocean blue scale — there is no separate gray in this system.
Do keep buttons and badges fully pill-shaped; keep cards and inputs on their own, smaller radius.
donts: Don't use a plain black or gray shadow anywhere — shadows are always ocean-tinted.
Don't use the reserved red (#DC2626) for anything other than "Critical" urgency and the active favorite heart.
Don't introduce a fourth accent hue — the system commits to exactly three (ocean, gold, leaf) plus the one reserved red.
Don't repeat the hero's tideline animation elsewhere as generic decoration; it is a one-place signature, not a reusable pattern.
